book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Lihengo lya akatenga na ghibhapalwa kupelwa
Bho, ne nekekiwe jhe? Bho, ne natenga jhe? Bho, nenga nimwe jhe Yecho Bhambo gwito? Bho, mangota lihengo lyango jhe kwa kulombana na Bhambo?
Ata ikabhii kwa bhando bhange ne natenga jhe, nambo kwino mangota nenga ndi natenga. Mangota ndi mulangiya utenga gwango kwa nhwalo gwa kulombana kwino na Bhambo.
Naha chinikikengelela kwa bhando bhubhangonya,
bho, tupalwa ndeka kupelwa chakulye na chakunywegha kwa nhwalo gwa lihengo lito?
Bho, tukwete jhe ukindendeke gwa kutolela mwikeghe jwahobholela Kilichitu mukutyanga, ngita chibhahenga akatenga bhange, akalongo bhake Bhambo, na Kefa?
Amu ndi nenga na Banaba tugha tupalwa kupata ilebhe hito kwa kuhenga lihengo?
Bho, nkomana ngondo ghane jwalepa mbijha kwa lihengo lyake? Bho, nnema ghane jwangalyegha uhoe gwa nng'onda gwake gwa chambalau? Bho, nnucha ghane jwaikoleka jwanganywegha mabhele gha inyama yake?
Bho, nilonge malobhe ghanga kwa kimundo tugha? Bho, lilaghalikilo lya Mucha ilongela jhe naha?
Nhwalo ijhandikwe mu lilaghalikilo lya Mucha, “Nkotoka kuntabha nnomo ng'ombi pabula mponga.” Bho, ibhii na mana Chapanga ilongelela ng'ombi?
Bho, palongela gheniya alongii jhe panane jha malobhe ghito? Chakaka ghanga ghajhandikwe kwa nhwalo gwito, nhwalo jhola jwalema na jhola jwahuna, bhoha bhihobholela kupata mahuno.
Anda twenga tumichita mbejho jha kiuhuke pakate jhino, bho, kilebhe kikolongwa twenga kupata ghitupala kuhumii kwino?

Anda bhando bhange bhipalwa kupata gheniya kubhoke kwino, bho, twenga tupalwa jhe kupata kuliku bhene? Nambo, twenga tuntumii jhe ukindendeke gwenio. Tuhimbilila mu kila kilebhe kupala Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Kilichitu likotoka kubhujha unyuma.
Bho, umanyingine jhe kubhehe bhubhahenga lihengo mu Nyumba jha Chapanga bhipata yakulegha mwenio, na bhubhabheka litambiko pakichangwale bhipata kilebhe mwenio mu litambiko?
Helahela Bhambo akalaghalikiye naha, bhala bhibhatangachii bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone bhapate ilebhe yabhe ibhaipala kubhoke mwenio.
Nambo nikajhopite jhe hilu kilebhe chimo. Amu nikajhandike ndeka kupala undendele gheniya. Kwa nenga mbaha kuwegha kuliku kuntenda mundo anole anda nenga nikiloka jhajhe.
Anda nenga nitangacha Malobhe gha Mbone, chenie kilebhe jhe cha kukiloka. Lyenio ndi lihengo limpekiwe. Chanola choto anda natangachii jhe bhando Lilobhe lya Mbone!
Anda nihenga lihengo lende kwa kupala namwete, ngahobholile kulepwa, nambo anda nenga nipalwa kuhenga lihengo lende, ilangii kubhehe Chapanga ambekii nenga kuhenga lende.
Bho, malepo ghango kilebhe ghane? Panatangachii bhando nipala jhe kulepwa chochoha, nijhopa jhe malepo kwa lihengo lya kutangacha Lilobhe lya Mbone.
Nenga nabhanda jhe bha mundo jhojhoha. Nikibhekite nabhanda kwa kila mundo nhwalo kunnete Kilichitu bhando bha mahele.

Punikibha kwa Akayahude ndamita ngita Akayahude kupala kwapata Akayahude, pamonga na nenga kubhehe pahe jha lilaghalikilo lya Mucha, nambo nikibha ngita pahe jha lilaghalikilo lyenio, kupala kwapata bheniya bhubhabhii pahe jha lilaghalikilo lya Mucha.

Punikibha na bhando bhangalongochwa na lilaghalikilo lya Mucha, nikibha ngita bheniya ngita ngwetejhe lilaghalikilo, kupala kwapata bhala bhangabhehe na lilaghalikilo lya Mucha. Kulonge yenio nenga anda nikengama jhe lilaghalikilo lya Chapanga, nhwalo mbungwitwe na lilaghalikilo lya Kilichitu.

Punikibha na bhando bhala bhubhabhii leghele nikatamite helahela ngita chibhabhii bhene, kupala kwapata bhene bhubhabhii leghelike. Nikitehi kila kilebhe kwa bhando bhoha kupala kwakombola kwa ndela jhojhoha jhela.
Hengite ghanga ghoha kwa nhwalo gwa Lilobhe lya Mbone, na nenga mbate mota yake.
Bho, umanya jhe bhando pa bhabhutuka, bhoha bhabhutuka, nambo jhola jwabhalongolela bhajhake ndi jwapata hupo? Mmutuke yenio mpate hupo.
Mundo jhojhoha jwapala kwapeta bhajhake mukubhutuka, hote aghaleka ghoha, ahenga naha kupala apate hupo jhihangabhika! Nambo twenga tuhenga naha kwa nhwalo gwa kupata kilemba changahangabhika.
Yene nibhutuka ngita mundo jhumbala kwalongolela, nikomana jhe ngita mundo akomana na upepo.
Nambo ning'ahicha yegha jhango na kulongocha, nihenga yenio kupala pumbala kujhomolela kwatangachii bhando bhange ne namwete ngoto kukanilwa mukupoke hupo.
